43d0baa83ad79244: You should know how to generate an image, save a clip, and make basic edits in an editor. If you have not done that yet, start with Image Prompting, Kling AI, and CapCut. This lab brings those skills together.

aa21510ee8527d36: The cases do not promise sales, reach, product performance, or a finished ad in ten minutes. Label the fictional demonstrations. A step remains pending until you have the required file.
